description: Log one user-confirmed business trip; writes on call, no server preview. Saved mode selects rate-based expense or distance-only trip; trackingMode overrides. For routes, vehicle setup/readings, imports or review, open Mileage and travel via get_spreadsheet_url.

date.description: Required YYYY-MM-DD. Use the given date; for today use the user's timezone. Ask if missing.

operationId.description: Stable ID required for trip_log; reuse for the same request; never repeat an unverified save.

trackingMode.description: Optional override; otherwise saved mode. Never infer from country or occupation.

unit.description: Trip-log unit; omit for saved. Expense uses configured unit.

vehicleId.description: Existing vehicle ID; omit for unassigned; never invent.

name: add_mileage_entry
